date.description: UTC date of the owner's message

source.description: First 8 characters of the Claude Code session id the report came from

owner_report.description: The owner's words, at most 25 words; '...' marks a cut

surface.description: An id from .agents/design/mockups/catalog.json, or null when none matches

app.description: Which implementation the defect was reported against

pre_fix_ref.description: Commit just before the fix (first parent of fix_ref); null when no fix is known

fix_ref.description: Commit that fixed it, when known

fix_confidence.description: How sure the fix_ref is the fix for this report (matched by commit subject and date)

expected.description: What a good design review of pre_fix_ref must flag
